title: Qatan's conditional online call to gather camel herds
notes: GCHR reproduces a 21 February conditional tweet proposing a gathering if the Salalah Plain decision remained in place. The opened article gives no event date or attendance and does not say the proposal was carried out; an online call is not a public gathering.

title: Arrest of environmental activist Ahmed Issa Qatan
notes: GCHR reports Qatan's 23 February arrest following summons; the 2022 Freedom House report also discusses his later sentence. Arrest and online criticism do not establish an executed public gathering. The arrest date is not coded as an event date.

title: Arrests of Salem al-Maashani and Amer Bait Saeed over opposition to Dhofar Plain plans
notes: The April 2021 ProtectDefenders alert reports, attributing the information to GCHR, that the activists were arrested on 28 February and held until 10 March; it describes social-media opposition, not a public gathering. Freedom House later reports detention for online criticism. These reports are not independent corroboration, and detention is not attendance.

title: General Federation of Oman Workers complaint and settlement records, 31 January–4 February
notes: The exact Times of Oman URL was body-read in the Oman January dossier; this unit consulted that saved review only and issued no new body request. Its scope describes five worker-rights complaints and administrative settlements/agreements, not a public gathering, strike or protest. Keep its prior-unit consultation separate from current-unit body reads.

title: Oman demonstrations against unemployment and VAT reported for May 2021
notes: The retrospective Freedom House country report places these demonstrations in May 2021, outside the February onset window. They belong to separate follow-up research and are not moved into this unit.
